conventions.pairing: same initial beliefs, topology, wealth quantiles, evidence, and contacts across all fractions and payment modes; same nested signed-edge masks across wealth distributions
conventions.legacy_prefix: first min(500, rounds) inputs exactly from existing make_inputs; horizon stability guaranteed for final horizons at least 500
conventions.continuation: after round 500: default_rng(SeedSequence([seed, 1398228293, stream])); stream=1 evidence, stream=2 contacts; time-major contact uniforms mapped uniformly to each payer's sorted neighbors
conventions.opponents: edge uniforms from the existing sixth SeedSequence(seed).spawn(6) stream; edge is negative iff uniform < opponent_fraction
conventions.cash: SHA256 of full wealth[1:] and payment byte streams required identical across fractions within each seed, wealth distribution, and payment rule
conventions.uncertainty: sample SD across seeds, not confidence intervals
conventions.belief_mse: mean posterior variance + mean squared error of posterior means relative to true_bias
conventions.truth_support: true_bias must occur on theta grid; truth_excluded_fraction counts exactly zero mass; singleton_fraction counts exactly one nonzero grid mass, without tolerance or probability floors
conventions.absorbing_disagreement_floor: agents at an interior singleton belief with no allied neighbors are permanently frozen; sqrt(sum of their squared deviations from their own mean / total number of agents) bounds all future population disagreement, conditional on updates remaining defined
conventions.late_windows: exact per-round means on inclusive [T//2+1, 3*T//4] and [3*T//4+1, T], independent of saved trajectory stride
conventions.limitations: fixed theta grid and signed update with support-erasing projection; finite-horizon averages do not establish an equilibrium or phase boundary; a positive absorbing-disagreement floor separately certifies nonvanishing disagreement under unchanged dynamics; no empirical calibration
